title: KTimer
description: A mod that adds a Timer to minecraft and it's super customizable!
body:
# KTimer

**KTimer** is a simple and modern client-side Fabric mod that adds customizable timers to your Minecraft action bar.

Create countdowns or countups directly with commands, pause, resume, reset or remove them, and fully customize the look of the timer through the Mod Menu config screen.

## Features

- Create multiple timers with simple commands
- Countdown and countup support
- Pause, resume, reset and remove timers
- Show or hide the timer text in the action bar
- Smooth animated gradient text
- Compact time format like `2h 26m 8s`
- Custom display text with placeholders
- Many selectable colors and gradients
- Separate expandable gradient and color menus
- Gradient pages and color pages for cleaner configuration
- Configurable keybind for showing/hiding the timer text
- Configurable keybind for opening the KTimer config screen
- Keybinds are shown under the **KTimer** category in Minecraft controls
- Built-in config screen
- Mod Menu support

## Commands

```text
/timer add <name> <countdown/countup> <time>
/timer pause <name>
/timer resume <name>
/timer reset <name>
/timer remove <name>
/timer show <true/false>
/timer clear
/timer config
